# algosec_trusted_traffic (Data Source)

Read-only trusted-traffic inventory for a device tree name or ALL_FIREWALLS. Reads all advertised pages; the upstream API can omit zero-hit rows, so this data source is not an authoritative drift source for mutations.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "algosec_trusted_traffic" "example" {
  device_name = "ExampleDevice"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `device_name` (String) Device name.

### Read-Only

- `entries` (Attributes List) Complete returned inventory, deterministically ordered. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--entries))
- `id` (String) Lookup identity.

<a id="nestedatt--entries"></a>
### Nested Schema for `entries`

Read-Only:

- `comment` (String) Comment.
- `destination` (String) Destination.
- `display_traffic_level` (String) Display traffic level.
- `expiration_date` (Number) Expiration date. Unix milliseconds; null if absent.
- `id` (Number) Id.
- `service` (String) Service.
- `source` (String) Source.
- `trust_future_host_group_changes` (Boolean) Trust future host group changes.
